# Pablo D. Sagarna Proietti

> CTO and Director of Enterprise Architecture & AI (WSO2, ex-Accenture, MuleSoft/Salesforce, IBM). 20+ years in enterprise architecture, integration and digital transformation across Europe and LATAM; recent focus on generative and agentic AI, MCP governance and LLM gateways. Contact: psagarna+job@gmail.com
